draft.one_line: Alexander Wiederin wants to renew his Registered Office Address service at £29 + VAT and is asking how to pay.
at_a_glance: Request received 23/09/2026 10:24 from alex@wiederin.xyz, replying to a "Service Will Renew Soon" reminder; he asks to renew the Registered Office Address at £29 + VAT.
No company name or company number given in the ticket, so the account has not been identified yet.
eFiling record: nothing returned for this ticket, so we have no confirmation of which services are active, expired or cancelled, and no renewal date.
Companies House record: not found for this ticket, so we cannot yet confirm the company status or whether 128 City Road sits on the Registered Office, Officers or PSC records.
Sender's email has not been matched against the registered primary email on any account, so no account specifics can be discussed until it is.

Director's Service Address position unknown; minimum cover to stay protected is Registered Office £29 + VAT plus Officer's Service Address £28 + VAT per officer, so this may need adding once the file is open.
No prior tickets on record for this customer.
Accounts, Confirmation Statement and officer identity-verification positions are all unknown because neither record was retrieved.
He has asked to renew rather than cancel, so no Companies House address removal is in play and no retention discount is needed at this stage.
risk_flags: Company and account not identified, so the renewal date is unknown and the service could lapse while we wait for details.
Sender's email not yet verified as the registered primary email on the account; no account detail can be shared until it is.
If the service lapses while our address is still on the Companies House record, the statutory post cannot be released and continued use may have to be reported to Companies House.
draft.proposed_message:
Hi Alexander,

Thanks for letting me know you'd like to keep the Registered Office Address running, that's an easy one to sort.

I've just had a look on our side, but I can't match your email address to a company record yet, so I don't want to guess and renew the wrong thing. Could you send me the company name and company number? And if the account was set up under a different email address, please let me know which one, as I can only go through account details with the email that's registered on the account.

As soon as I have that, I'll open your file, confirm exactly which services you hold and the date the renewal falls due, then raise the invoice for you. The Registered Office Address is £29 + VAT a year, just as you say. If any of your directors also use our address as their Service Address, that's £28 + VAT per director per year, and I'll tell you straight away whether that applies to you.

To pay, log in at https://www.yourcompanyformations.co.uk/login/, click "My Invoice History", select the order number and click "Make Payment". One thing worth knowing, our system doesn't notify us when a payment comes through, so please reply to this email once you've paid and I'll check it and get the renewal applied.

I'd like to get this wrapped up before your renewal date passes. If an address service lapses while our address is still showing at Companies House, we can't release your statutory post, and that's the sort of thing that causes real headaches later, so I'd rather we stayed ahead of it.

If anything above isn't clear, just reply and I'll pick it straight up.

Best wishes,
Rona
suggested_actions: Search eFiling admin for alex@wiederin.xyz and for "Wiederin" to try to locate the account before the customer replies; note the https://admin.efiling.co.uk/company-details/?i=XXXXXXX link on the ticket once found.
Confirm alex@wiederin.xyz is the registered primary email on that account; if it is not, share no account detail and ask him to resend from the registered email.
List every active, expired and cancelled service with the exact renewal date (dd/mm/yyyy), and check whether each was set to auto-renew.

Check whether the "Service Will Renew Soon" reminder actually relates to the Registered Office or to a separate service such as Premium 12 Month Company Filing or Mail Forwarding, and correct the scope if so.

Check Companies House for our address on the Registered Office, Officers (Director's Service Address) and PSC records, and note whether a Director's Service Address at £28 + VAT per director also needs renewing.

Check for any outstanding compliance hold (Credas identity verification or Proof of Address re-upload) that would stop the service activating even once paid; notify the Compliance Team if one is open.
Raise the renewal invoice for the confirmed services and send the portal payment path (login, My Invoice History, select Order #, Make Payment), asking him to reply once paid.
Note the Confirmation Statement and accounts position while the record is open, and flag the CS filing service at £90 + VAT separately if it is due.
Close the conversation after replying and reopen when he comes back with the company details.
open_questions: What is the company name and company number?
Is alex@wiederin.xyz the registered primary email on the account?
Which services are on the account, and what is the exact renewal date?
Does a Director's Service Address (£28 + VAT per director) also need renewing, or is our address only on the Registered Office record?
Is our address still showing on the Companies House Registered Office, Officers and PSC records?
Is there any outstanding Credas verification or Proof of Address requirement that would delay activation?

draft.proposed_message:
Hi Josep,

Thanks for coming back to me, and good to hear the Companies House verification is already done. That's a helpful step out of the way.

I've just had a look at the file for CODEBYME LTD and it's still showing as Submitted on our side, which means it hasn't gone across to Companies House yet. To move it on, could you reply here with Ernesto's Companies House personal code? We can't retrieve it from Companies House ourselves, so we do need it from you in writing.

The other thing I didn't want you to be caught out by is that there are two separate checks going on here, and it's easily missed. The Companies House verification is one. On top of that, we're legally required to run our own identity and anti-money-laundering check on the officers, which we do through Credas, and the application can't be processed until that's complete. Our Compliance Team will send Ernesto a Credas invitation by email.

Here's what would help most:

1. Reply to this email with Ernesto's Companies House personal code.
2. Keep an eye out for the Credas invitation. If it hasn't landed within 30 minutes, please check the spam or junk folder and tell me if it's still missing so I can chase it.
3. Complete it on a smartphone. You'll need one photo ID (a passport, photocard driving licence or national identity card), in colour, clear and readable, showing an issue date and not expiring within the next 45 days. You'll also need one proof of address dated within the last 3 months, personally addressed, showing the full home address, and in English or with an official sworn translation.
4. Please don't skip any question during the Credas registration, including date of birth and address, as missed fields are the most common cause of a failed check.
5. Reply to me once the upload is done. Our system doesn't notify us automatically, so your confirmation is genuinely what keeps the order moving.

One small note on ID: a driving licence is fine as photo ID, but it isn't accepted as proof of address, and neither are tenancy agreements or residence certificates. If you're using a bank statement, it needs to show a few transactions rather than being a brand new account.

If anything above is unclear, or if you'd like me to have the Credas invite sent to a different email for Ernesto, just say and I'll sort it.

Best wishes,
Rona
suggested_actions: Reply to Josep asking for Ernesto's Companies House personal code in writing and explaining that Credas is a separate legal AML requirement (ID01 wording for document rules).
Ask the Compliance Team to send (or resend) the Credas verification invitation to Ernesto Miguel Rodriguez Rodriguez on eFiling 3376790, and confirm which email or mobile it goes to.
Check the note history on the record first so a Credas invite compliance has already sent is not duplicated.

Check the order behind eFiling 3376790: the services block shows 0 active services while 128 City Road is set as the registered office, so confirm the Registered Office service is on the order and paid. Raise the invoice via the portal path (login, My Invoice History, select order, Make Payment) if anything is outstanding.
Once the personal code arrives, pass it to Compliance so the Submitted application can proceed to Companies House.
When the customer confirms the Credas upload is complete, notify the Compliance Team and tell the customer it has been passed on.
Keep the ticket open until both the personal code and the Credas pass are confirmed, then close. Review/survey ask only once the company is formed and the customer is happy.
